en.title: Rick Riordan's Kane Chronicles Officially Coming to Disney+ Series
en.summary: The beloved Egyptian mythology series is set for a live-action adaptation on Disney+. Author Rick Riordan is co-creating the show, bringing his signature touch to the magical world.
en.body:
Disney+ is expanding its Rick Riordan universe, officially announcing a live-action series based on **The Kane Chronicles** trilogy. This move follows the ongoing development of the **Percy Jackson and the Olympians** series, signaling a strong commitment from the streamer to Riordan's expansive literary worlds. The author himself is deeply involved, co-creating the show with **Angela Robinson**, a seasoned writer and producer known for her work on **True Blood** and **The L Word**, and who also directed the film **Professor Marston and the Wonder Women**.

The **Kane Chronicles** centers on siblings Carter and Sadie Kane, who are thrust into a hidden world of Egyptian gods and magic after their father, an Egyptologist, unleashes the chaos god Set during an experiment at the British Museum. Separated for years, the siblings discover their lineage connects them to ancient pharaohs and a secret order tasked with safeguarding the world from mythological threats. Their journey is a globetrotting quest to defeat Set and understand their own burgeoning powers.

This adaptation marks a significant moment for fans who have long championed the **Kane Chronicles**. The books, praised for their unique blend of ancient Egyptian lore and modern-day adventure, have garnered a passionate following. The news that Riordan is co-creating the series offers a strong assurance that the adaptation will remain true to the spirit and intricate plotting of the original novels. The previous development of the series at Netflix also highlights the enduring appeal and potential of this story.

## The Gods Are Waking

The premise of **The Kane Chronicles** dives deep into the pantheon of Egyptian gods, bringing figures like Ra, Isis, Osiris, and the formidable Set into a contemporary setting. The story explores themes of family, destiny, and the struggle between order and chaos, all through the eyes of two relatable teenagers grappling with extraordinary circumstances. Carter and Sadie's journey is not just about mastering magic but also about understanding their heritage and their place in a world where gods walk among mortals.

## What's Next for the Kane Siblings

Details surrounding the casting and release date for **The Kane Chronicles** series have not yet been announced. However, with **Percy Jackson and the Olympians** season three slated for November 20, 2026, Disney+ is clearly prioritizing Riordan's adaptations. Fans can anticipate further updates as development progresses, with the hope that the **Kane Chronicles** will offer another compelling chapter in the streamer's growing library of fantasy content.

content_raw: News kane chronicles Rick Riordan’s Kane Chronicles Are Coming to Disney+ Can Magnus Chase be far behind? By Molly Templeton | Published on September 4, 2026 Comment 0 Share New Share We’re not even halfway through Percy Jackson , and Disney+ is already certain it wants more Rick Riordan. Deadline brings the news that the streaming platform is now developing a live-action adaptation of Riordan’s Kane Chronicles—and, as with Percy , Riordan himself is co-creating the show. He’s working with Angela Robinson, an experienced writer and producer whose resume includes time on True Blood and The L Word , and who wrote and directed the film Professor Marston and the Wonder Women . (She also directed two episodes of Wednesday .) The Kane Chronicles are about two siblings, Carter and Sadie Kane, who grew up apart after their mother died. Carter explored the world with their Egyptologist father, while Sadie stayed in London with their grandparents. But, as the synopsis explains: One night, Dr. Kane brings the siblings together for a “research experiment” at the British Museum, where he hopes to set things right for his family. Instead, he unleashes the Egyptian god Set, who banishes him to oblivion and forces the children to flee for their lives. Soon, Sadie and Carter discover that the gods of Egypt are waking, and the worst of them—Set—has his sights on the Kanes. To stop him, the siblings embark on a dangerous journey across the globe–a quest that brings them ever closer to the truth about their family, and their links to a secret order that has existed since the time of the pharaohs. The logline for the series is more succinct: “When their father unleashes the god of chaos and vanishes, the estranged Kane siblings must master their inherited Egyptian magic, forge unlikely alliances, and rescue their father before warring gods can wreak havoc on our modern world.” This series (which was previously in development as a Netflix film ) takes place in the same world as Riordan’s other book series, which include the Camp Half-Blood Chronicles and the Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard books—and yes, there have been crossovers. What that means for Disney’s series remains to be seen.[end-mark] The post Rick Riordan’s Kane Chronicles Are Coming to Disney+ appeared first on Reactor .
